details: The United States launched its seventh consecutive night of strikes on Iranian military and infrastructure targets. In retaliation, Iran attacked US radar sites and military aircraft in allied nations such as Qatar and Bahrain. This escalating conflict has significantly heightened tensions around the Strait of Hormuz, a vital shipping route for global oil and gas. Reports indicate reduced transits and a renewed US naval blockade in the strait, contributing to a rise in global energy prices. Additionally, Iran announced the suspension of its commitments under an interim deal with the US.
title: US-Iran Conflict Escalates, Strait of Hormuz Tensions Rise
